column8: prompt（竖线分隔，{陆沉}/{苏晚} 为人物占位符）
prompt

EXACTLY TWO people. {苏晚} stands at the half-open wooden door in the BACK RIGHT corner of the room, FAR AWAY from the desk, one foot already outside, documents held against her chest, one hand lifted as if about to knock, glancing back toward the desk. The man stays seated in the RIGHT foreground with his back to the camera, not looking up.

Focus on {苏晚}: standing at the guest side of the desk facing the camera, she places documents on the desktop, glances at the empty paper cup, then lifts her eyes with a small polite smile. The man remains only as the blurred back-shoulder in the right foreground.

EXACTLY ONE person, only LUCHEN. Medium shot. {陆沉} seated upright BEHIND the desk facing the camera, turning a page, then pausing; his gaze shifts to the cream cardigan draped over his chair back. The guest side of the desk stays empty.

EXACTLY ONE woman visible. {苏晚} seated on the grey fabric sofa along the LEFT wall, leaning back, a coffee cup on the low table beside her, looking toward the desk. The desk area and the guest side are COMPLETELY EMPTY, she is far away from the desk. The man remains only as the blurred back-shoulder in the right foreground.

Two-person coffee handover: from the right foreground the man's hand pushes a fresh coffee cup across the desk toward {苏晚}; she stands at the guest side facing the camera, reaching for the cup with both hands, her face clearly visible.

Close medium shot on {苏晚} facing the camera: she looks down at the new coffee cup in her hands, one hand loosening her bag strap, voice tense, expression restrained. The man remains only as the blurred back-shoulder in the right foreground.

EXACTLY ONE person, only LUCHEN. Medium shot, same seat and angle as the master. {陆沉} seated upright BEHIND the desk facing the camera with a pen in hand, eyes lowered to the papers, calm flat expression. The guest side of the desk stays empty.

Two-person letter handover: {苏晚} stands at the guest side facing the camera, having just pushed a folded letter across the desk, her hand still resting on the letter, her face clearly visible; from the right foreground the man's hand reaches for the letter.

Extreme close-up PORTRAIT of {陆沉}: his face fills the upper half of the frame, looking down at a folded letter held in both hands just below his chin, thumb smoothing the crease, reading slowly with a subtle pause; warm desk lamp glow from frame right, cool blue window light from frame left; framing crops at his shoulders, no desk, no furniture, no full body, no second person.

EXACTLY ONE person, only LUCHEN. Medium shot, same seat and angle as the master. {陆沉} seated upright BEHIND the desk facing the camera, folds the letter back and pushes it toward the guest side toward the camera, formal controlled expression.

Enclosed private executive office at NIGHT, no other people anywhere, empty company floor. Extreme close-up PORTRAIT of {苏晚}: her face fills the upper half of the frame, she holds a returned letter with both hands just below her chin and lifts her eyes, tentative, hopeful and nervous; the blurred background bokeh shows only a dark grey sofa and dark wood shelving in shadow; cool blue ambient light from frame left, warm fill from frame right; framing crops at her shoulders, no desk, no monitors, no other people, no full body, no second person.

EXACTLY ONE person, only LUCHEN. Medium shot. The black executive chair behind the desk is EMPTY, no one sits at the desk. {陆沉} stands beside the desk on its left side toward the sofa, desk next to him, window light behind, entire body from head to brown leather ankle boots visible; he takes one half step toward the guest side and stops.

EXACTLY ONE woman visible. {苏晚} seated on the grey fabric sofa along the LEFT wall far from the desk, holding the finished coffee cup with both hands, gazing away to the side with a quiet exhale. The desk area and the guest side are COMPLETELY EMPTY, no one near the desk. The man remains only as the blurred back-shoulder in the right foreground.

EXACTLY TWO people. {苏晚} stands at the half-open wooden door at the BACK RIGHT, turning back over her shoulder to call his name, her face clearly visible. The man in the right foreground turns his shoulders toward the door, looking at her.

EXACTLY ONE person, only LUCHEN. Medium shot. {陆沉} stands at the dark wooden door at the RIGHT edge of frame, leaning against the doorframe, one hand on the door edge, watching the empty warm-lit corridor through the open door. The desk with the lit lamp remains visible in the background. The corridor is completely empty, no silhouette.

Keep image 1 exactly as it is: same composition, furniture, night-office background and lighting, and the man seated in the RIGHT foreground with his back to the camera. ADD the woman from her character sheet STANDING at the half-open wooden door in the BACK RIGHT corner of the room, far away from the desk, documents held against her chest, one hand lifted as if about to knock, glancing toward the desk. Exactly two people in the scene.

Keep image 1 unchanged except the action at the desk: the woman (match her character sheet and face close-up) stands at the guest side of the desk facing the camera, places documents on the desktop, glances at the empty paper cup, then lifts her eyes with a small polite smile. The man remains only as the blurred back-shoulder in the right foreground.

Replace the man seated upright behind the desk with the person from the character sheet and the face close-up (face highest priority): he turns a page then pauses, gaze shifting to the cream cardigan draped over his chair back. Keep everything else exactly unchanged; the guest side of the desk stays empty.

Keep image 1's composition, furniture and lighting. Change the action into a coffee handover: from the right foreground the man (match his character sheet) pushes a fresh coffee cup across the desk toward the woman; the woman (match her character sheet) stands at the guest side facing the camera reaching for the cup with both hands, her face clearly visible. Exactly two people in the scene.
